{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# Recovery-Aware Structured Pruning

Code for the paper "Recovery-Aware Structured Pruning for LLM Reasoning" (submitted to EMNLP 2026).

## Overview

This repository provides the implementation for structured pruning of large language models with recovery-aware criteria. We demonstrate that the choice of pruning criterion determines post-pruning recovery capacity under reinforcement learning (GRPO).

Key components:
- **CKA-based functional overlap scoring** for identifying redundant layers
- **RASP composite scoring** combining CKA overlap with Taylor importance
- **Floor ratio** mechanism to preserve minimum layer capacity
- **GRPO recovery training** pipeline for pruned models
- **Multi-benchmark evaluation** (GSM8K, MBPP, MATH-500, HumanEval)

## Requirements

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Usage

### 1. Pruning

```bash
python src/prune.py \
  --model_path <path_to_model> \
  --output_path <output_dir> \
  --sparsity_ratio 0.2 \
  --scoring_method cka_only \
  --floor_ratio 0.4
```

Supported scoring methods: `cka_only`, `standard`, `rasp`, `random`

### 2. GRPO Recovery Training

```bash
python src/train_grpo_v5.py \
  --model_path <pruned_or_sft_checkpoint> \
  --output_dir <output_dir> \
  --max_steps 100 \
  --learning_rate 1e-6 \
  --beta 0.01 \
  --temperature 0.4
```

### 3. Evaluation

```bash
# GSM8K
python src/eval_gsm8k.py \
  --model_path <model_path> \
  --max_samples 1319 \
  --output_path results/eval_gsm8k.json

# MBPP
python src/eval_mbpp.py \
  --model_path <model_path> \
  --output_path results/eval_mbpp.json

# MATH-500
python src/eval_math500.py \
  --model_path <model_path> \
  --output_path results/eval_math500.json

# HumanEval
python src/eval_humaneval.py \
  --model_path <model_path> \
  --output_path results/eval_humaneval.json
```

### 4. Analysis

```bash
# CKA layer overlap analysis
python src/cka_overlap.py --model_path <model_path>

# CKA stability analysis
python src/cka_stability_analysis.py --original_model <base_model> --pruned_model <pruned_model>

# Gradient flow analysis
python src/gradient_flow_analysis.py --model_path <model_path>

# Inference speed measurement
python src/measure_inference_speed.py
```

### 5. Pipeline Scripts

End-to-end pipeline scripts are provided in `scripts/`:

```bash
# Floor ratio ablation
bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh

# Alpha ablation
bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation.sh
```

## Project Structure

```
src/                        # Core source code
  prune.py                  # Structured pruning with CKA/RASP scoring
  cka_overlap.py            # CKA functional overlap computation
  importance_score.py       # Taylor importance scoring
  rasp_scoring.py           # RASP composite scoring
  model_utils.py            # Model utility functions
  train_grpo.py             # GRPO training
  train_grpo_v5.py          # GRPO training (main version)
  sft_recovery.py           # SFT recovery training
  eval_gsm8k.py             # GSM8K evaluation
  eval_mbpp.py              # MBPP evaluation
  eval_math500.py           # MATH-500 evaluation
  eval_humaneval.py         # HumanEval evaluation
  prune_shortgpt.py         # ShortGPT baseline
  prune_unstructured.py     # Unstructured pruning baseline
scripts/                    # Pipeline shell scripts
figures/                    # Figure generation scripts
```

## Citation

```bibtex
(To be added after publication)
```
